class.name: harambe_ankle_ethercat_driver/HarambeEthercatDriver
class.description: CSP/CST EtherCAT driver for the Harambe humanoid with the EXACT differential-ankle serial-chain transform (closed-form IK / Newton FK, stacked-hinge cross-coupling). Command layout: position, effort, mode_of_operation. Inherits ethercat_driver/EthercatDriver.

class.name: harambe_ankle_ethercat_driver/HarambePvtDriver
class.description: PVT (CiA 402 mode 5) EtherCAT driver for the Harambe humanoid with the EXACT differential-ankle serial-chain transform. Command layout: position, velocity, effort, kp, kd (kp/kd per-motor passthrough). Shares the exact ankle kinematics with the CSP/CST driver via AnkleLinkageDriver.
